notes.subject: ol Midian vs ol Ismael
notes.rationale: Stat 37:25 i tok 'ol Ismael', ves 36 i tok 'ol Midian' — tupela i tok long wanpela lain o ol lain i wankain

notes.subject: סריס
notes.rationale: 'saris' — man i wok long haus bilong ol meri bilong king; KJV 'ofisa' i lusim piksa

notes.subject: הטבחים
notes.rationale: ol man bilong kotim — 'tabach' em i man bilong katim; 'bikman bilong ol soldia' i tok bilong KJV tasol

translation: Na ol Midian ol i selim ⟨את⟩ em i go long Mitsrayim, long Potifar, man bilong wok long haus bilong Paro, king bilong Mitsrayim, na bikman bilong ol man i save katim ol man.

tokens.gloss: man bilong wok long haus bilong king
ol man i save katim ol man
